facts.new:
mock_modules = [sys.modules.get("mock"), sys.modules.get("unittest.mock")]
    if any(mock_modules):
        # We iterate through the patched attributes looking for the mock
        # sentinel DEFAULT.  Identity comparison is used instead of the
        # ``in`` operator because the latter would call ``__eq__`` on
        # ``p.new``, which raises (e.g. for numpy arrays) or can produce a
        # non-boolean result for arbitrary user objects.
        sentinels = [m.DEFAULT for m in mock_modules if m is not None]
        return len(
            [
                p
                for p in patchings
                if not p.attribute_name
                and any(p.new is sentinel for sentinel in sentinels)
            ]
        )
    return len(patchings)
